name: win_sysmon
notes: The source most Windows process_creation detection content targets. Parent and child are paired per record rather than chosen independently: picking them separately produces combinations such as userinit.exe spawning powershell.exe, which is genuinely suspicious and makes ordinary baseline traffic trip high-severity rules. Each record below is a process lineage that really occurs on a workstation.
